name: Dragon Knight II
source:
An evil sorceress named Mesaanya has captured all the girls of the city of Phoenix and turned them into monsters. Only a young warrior and traveler Takeru Yamato is brave enough to break her spells.

In order to save the girls and change them back to normal, Takeru must storm the witch's tower, find each girls sacred writings, and then remove the curse from each girl.

Luckily this time Takeru won't have to fight alone....

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dragon_Knight_II]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
邪恶女巫梅萨妮娅抓走了凤凰城里的所有少女，并把她们变成怪物。只有年轻的战士兼旅行者大和猛敢于挺身而出，破解她的魔法。

为了拯救少女，让她们恢复原状，猛必须闯入女巫之塔，找到每名少女的圣文，然后逐一解除她们身上的诅咒。

幸运的是，这一次猛不必孤军奋战…

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dragon_Knight_II]Wikipedia[/url]]
